usage.outputShape: body.content (assistant reply text); body.model (model id); body.usage.total_tokens / body.usage.cost
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/llm/llama with a JSON body containing an OpenAI-style messages array, e.g. {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}. Pay the x402 charge ($0.002 USDC on Base). The response is synchronous JSON; read the assistant's reply from body.content. Token/cost accounting is in body.usage.
